item.description:
Release v5.18.4

Changes since v5.18.3

  • feat(chat-section): add plugin-aware chat contexts
  • feat(chat): persist plugin chat section widths
  • feat(rail): persist plugin rail widths
  • feat(terminal): sync rail view visibility with visible tabs
  • fix: make API key keychain reads resilient
  • fix(chat-screenshot): show captured images in chat preview
  • refactor(code-editor): rename editor plugin packages
